_comment: bits store-token signer: the fourth security-proxy instance. Its only route signs the store tokens the backend issues (bits login, the console), with their own Ed25519 key, pushed by `make unlock` into the 'bits-store-token-key' slot from secrets/bits-store-token-key.enc.pem (make store-token-key). The backend mounts its agent socket; it cannot reach the manifest signer (M8b). Copy to STORE_TOKEN_SIGNER_CONFIG_DIR as config.json (root-owned, read-only). 'cert' is a never-provisioned slot: the daemon needs a credential of some kind, the local sign route needs no TLS.
